title: Panchamasali community to revive agitation for 2A reservation

ai.summary: The Lingayat Panchamasali community plans to restart its agitation for 2A reservation after a police lathi-charge in December 2024, with a hunger strike scheduled for December 10 in Belagavi.

facts.claim: The Lingayat Panchamasali community will revive an agitation demanding its inclusion in the 2A reservation category
facts.quote: The Lingayat Panchamasali community will revive an agitation demanding its inclusion in the 2A reservation category, following a prolonged wait for a response from the State government, said the former seer of Kudalasangam Sri Basava Jaya Mrutyunjay Swami.

facts.claim: The community suspended its agitation following a police lathi-charge on Panchamasali Lingayat protesters in Belagavi on December 10, 2024
facts.quote: Addressing a press conference in Kalaburagi on Wednesday, the seer said that the community suspended its agitation following a police lathi-charge on Panchamasali Lingayat protesters in Belagavi on December 10, 2024, during a protest march demanding inclusion in the 2A reservation category.

facts.claim: The agitation took place during Chief Minister Siddaramaiah’s tenure
facts.quote: The agitation took place during Chief Minister Siddaramaiah’s tenure. At the time, we announced that the community will resume its struggle only after a change in Chief Ministership.

facts.claim: The community has decided to revive its movement to press for its long-pending reservation demand
facts.quote: Following the subsequent change in political leadership, the community has decided to revive its movement to press for its long-pending reservation demand

facts.claim: A State-level hunger strike will be organised in front of the Suvarna Soudha in Belagavi on December 10
facts.quote: As part of the renewed agitation, a State-level hunger strike will be organised in front of the Suvarna Soudha in Belagavi on December 10.

facts.claim: The community approached Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar seeking a resolution to its reservation demand within two months of his assuming office, he had sought more time
facts.quote: The seer said that when the community approached Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar seeking a resolution to its reservation demand within two months of his assuming office, he had sought more time.

facts.claim: With no tangible progress so far, the community has decided to organise the hunger strike to remind the State government of its commitment
facts.quote: However, with no tangible progress so far, the community has decided to organise the hunger strike to remind the State government of its commitment and draw attention to its long-pending demand for 2A reservation.

ai.background_note: The Lingayat Panchamasali community has been advocating for 2A reservation since at least 2024, with a previous agitation suspended after police action in December 2024.
